rows: Speedometer | Display disappears when rheostat is turned with light S/W ON

content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart for speedometer display issue. Starts with question 'Only speedometer?' with Yes path leading to 'Replace speedometer' and No path leading to further diagnostic steps involving sub-harness SST testing and voltage checks.
labels: Remove meter and connect sub harness (SST)
1) With the ignition S/W at ON position, does voltage between terminals 1 and 16 of sub-harness vary from 0 to 9 V when rheostat is turned?
2) With the light S/W turned ON, does voltage between terminals TR and E of rheostat vary when rheostat is operated?
Is speedometer normal with other meters disconnected?
Bad wiring between rheostat and meter
Connect other meters one by one to find faulty one.

content.description: Two testing configurations shown. Left diagram (labeled 1) shows sub-harness (SST) connected to meter with terminals TR(1) and E(2) indicated. Right diagram (labeled 2) shows rheostat connected to meter with terminals TR and E indicated, and rheostat positions marked as MIN (Bright), OFF, and MAX (Fade).
